name: Umagoya Princess
source:
There is a small country called Mandamin.
A civil conflict has destroyed this country. During the war, the seal of the dungeon hidden in the castle was released and the country received many adventurers.

In the autonomous area of adventurers, the princess who was officially missing lived as a fugitive.
When her real identity was found, she thought that she was going to be killed, but instead, the adventurers protected her.
Without authority and power, she wished to become useful to them...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE054050.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
有一个叫曼达明的小国家。一场内乱摧毁了这个国家。战争期间，城堡中隐藏的地下城封印被释放，国家涌入了许多冒险者。在冒险者的自治区里，官方认定失踪的公主作为逃亡者生活着。当她的真实身份被发现时，她以为自己会被杀掉，但冒险者们反而保护了她。没有权力和力量的她，希望能对他们有所帮助……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE054050.html]DLsite English[/url]]
